title: Name the child path in rev5 submodule refusals where Git already provides it
outcome: A committed-input refusal for a submodule init, pin or mapping failure names the child path when Git's own output already carries it, without any extra Git call.
acceptance: When `git submodule status --recursive` reports a '+', '-' or 'U' row, the refusal names that row's child path.
When the status command itself fails and Git's bounded stderr names a path (for example 'no submodule mapping found in .gitmodules for path …'), the refusal includes that path.
No additional Git invocation is added, and the refusal category and fail-closed behaviour are unchanged.
